entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 110 to 140 mm of rain about the main divide, and 80 to 110 mm within 20 km farther east. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected Friday morning about the divide. Freezing level 2000 metres. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: This is a new Heavy Rain Warning for the next burst of heavy rain.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 100 to 130 mm of rain about the main divide, and 70 to 100 mm within 20 km farther east. Peak rates of 15 to 25 mm/h expected Thursday afternoon and evening about the divide. Freezing level 1500 metres rising to 2000 metres Thursday evening. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: This is a new Heavy Rain Warning for the next burst of heavy rain.

entry.title: Heavy Snow Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy snow above 800 metres, where snowfall amounts may approach warning criteria. Note, lesser amounts of snow could fall as low as 400 metres. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: In addition to what has already fallen, expect 200 to 350 mm of rain about the ranges, and 100 to 150 mm nearer the coast. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected from Thursday afternoon to Friday morning about the ranges. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.
